name: Project-SDSG
description: Project School Defying Software Games is well local html5 games you download on any school computer uses no wifi the school most likely cant ban them and its made by Mahdi Studios But Its just Me (Mahdiisdumb) doing the dirty work

paragraphs: Project‑SDSG is a collection of local HTML5 games designed to run on school or restricted computers. The games require no WiFi and are built so that they’re unlikely to be blocked by school network filters. The goal: fun, fast, and offline‑friendly games — made solo by me (Mahdiisdumb / Mahdi Studios).
features: Many schools block gaming websites. SDSG gives access to games without needing an internet connection.
It’s built to be lightweight and self‑contained so students can play games on any school computer without admin privileges or external dependencies.
It’s my personal project: a playground in code, testing my HTML5 / JS / frontend skills, and building something fun for peers.
